# Setting up my new digital garden

Today I built this super lightweight portfolio! It's just HTML, CSS, and JS. I wanted something visually rich but without the overhead of heavy frameworks. 

I managed to add:
- A neat Last.fm integration for what I'm listening to.
- A books section.
- And this markdown-powered blog!

Feeling really good about how fast this loads.

# Deep work sessions

Been reading *The Pragmatic Programmer* a lot lately. One of the best takeaways is treating your code like a garden—constantly weeding and nurturing it. I spent a few hours refactoring old projects and it felt incredibly rewarding.
